title: Listening Section 1: Spelling and Numbers
verifiableTask: Registrar dez dados exatos sem duplicação

content.text: : o IELTS não aceita resposta “quase certa”. Hoje você treina as letras que brasileiros confundem, números longos e autocorreções.
Ao final da aula você consegue:
anotar 10 dados exatos (nomes, códigos, telefones, preços) sem trocar letras nem repetir números.

explanations.general: Falso: escreva letra por letra enquanto ouve.

content.text: City Car Rentals, how can I help?
Hi, I'd like to collect a car I booked online.
It's H J 7 0 3… sorry, H G 7 0 3 9.
Got it. And a contact number?
Oh seven seven double one, four eight two, nine five six.
Thank you. You've booked a compact car for five days. That's £34.50 a day, so £172.50 in total. Is that right?
Yes, but can I add a child seat?
Of course, that's an extra £6 a day — so £30 for the five days.
Fine. What's the address of the pick-up point?
It's 118 Quayside Road — that's Q-U-A-Y-S-I-D-E — postcode NE1 3JW.
And what time do you close?

Surname: ______ 2. Booking reference: ______ 3. Phone: ______ 4. Price per day: £______ 5. Total (car only): £______ 6. Child seat (total): £______ 7. Street number: ______ 8. Street name: ______ Road 9. Postcode: ______ 10. Closing time: ______
